summary: `NEON_PROJECT_ID` is a required env row sourced from `neon-endpoints.mjs::LIVE_PROJECT`, so `env:render` writes it; the purge resolves its branch from the `NEON_AUTH_BASE_URL` endpoint when `NEON_BRANCH` names none.
reader_impact: Someone deleting their own account reaches the delete instead of an error after typing the confirmation phrase, and an operator is refused at `env:render` when the project id is missing rather than at the last step of a deletion.
